title: Site Reliability Engineer Learning Roadmap
summary: A focused path to solidify core SRE fundamentals, build practical skills, create a showcase portfolio, and prepare for job readiness. Each phase balances theory, hands‑on practice, and professional networking.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish a strong base in Linux, networking, and programming concepts essential for SRE work.

milestones.title: Programming Basics for Automation
milestones.outcome: Can write scripts to automate routine system tasks.

tasks.title: Complete Python Basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the first 3 sections covering variables, control flow, and functions.

tasks.title: Write a Log Rotation Script
tasks.description: Create a Bash script that archives logs older than 7 days and compresses them.

tasks.title: Parse JSON with Python
tasks.description: Write a short Python program that reads a JSON file and prints selected fields.

tasks.title: Automate Service Restart
tasks.description: Develop a script that checks a service status and restarts it if down.

tasks.title: Reflect on Code Quality
tasks.description: List three improvements you could make to your scripts for readability.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop observability, incident response, and reliability engineering practices.

milestones.title: Service Level Objectives (SLOs)
milestones.outcome: Can define, measure, and report SLOs for a service.

tasks.title: Read SLO Chapter from Google SRE Book
tasks.description: Focus on error budget concepts and how to choose metrics.

tasks.title: Define Service Error Budget
tasks.description: Pick a latency metric and calculate a 99.9% SLO for a demo app.

tasks.title: Implement Alerting for SLO Breach
tasks.description: Create a Prometheus alert rule that fires when error budget exceeds 5%.

tasks.title: Visualize SLO Burn Rate
tasks.description: Add a Grafana panel showing remaining error budget over time.

tasks.title: Reflect on SLO Trade‑offs
tasks.description: Write a brief analysis of how tighter SLOs affect reliability costs.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create tangible SRE projects that demonstrate monitoring, capacity planning, and post‑mortem skills.

milestones.title: Simulated Outage Postmortem
milestones.outcome: Can produce a clear, data‑driven postmortem document.

tasks.title: Trigger Service Failure
tasks.description: Kill the demo service and observe alerts from the monitoring stack.

tasks.title: Collect Timeline Data
tasks.description: Gather logs, metrics, and alert timestamps during the outage.

tasks.title: Write Detailed Postmortem
tasks.description: Follow the SRE postmortem template to explain cause and remediation.

tasks.title: Create Root‑Cause Diagram
tasks.description: Draw a simple fishbone diagram illustrating contributing factors.

tasks.title: Share Postmortem for Feedback
tasks.description: Post the document in an SRE forum and request critique.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance expertise, polish the portfolio, and position yourself for SRE roles.

milestones.title: SLO & Reliability Strategy Review
milestones.outcome: Can design and communicate reliability strategies aligned with business goals.

tasks.title: Read Reliability Engineering Blog Posts
tasks.description: Select two recent posts from the Reliability Engineering blog and note key takeaways.

tasks.title: Draft Service Reliability Plan
tasks.description: Outline monitoring, SLOs, and incident response for a hypothetical e‑commerce service.

tasks.title: Present Plan to Peer
tasks.description: Give a 10‑minute presentation and gather critique on clarity and feasibility.

tasks.title: Incorporate Feedback
tasks.description: Revise the reliability plan based on peer suggestions.

tasks.title: Reflect on Learning Journey
tasks.description: Summarize how your understanding of SLOs evolved throughout the roadmap.
